aboutme: Hello There! My name is Tymoteusz Kołodziejczyk, and I am a Software Developer. I enjoy building creative projects that benefit myself and those around me. Through this website, I aim to share my knowledge and experiences with others who are interested in learning programming and related topics. I'm interested in electronics and photography.

description: Contributed to the development of schowki.com, a self-storage platform, implementing, among others, SMS verification and integration with Polish KSeF e-invoicing system to ensure compliant electronic invoicing (C#/.NET, React).
Participated in improving CryptoMind, a mobile application focused on cryptocurrency market tracking (React Native).

subDescription.intro: Developed many smaller services and tools:
items: An Instagram chatbot using Gemini AI capable of managing multiple accounts simultaneously with account-separate knowledge bases (Python, SQLite3, Redis).
A device monitoring service that detects long disconnections in internal systems and sends automated email alerts to maintenance teams (Python).
An automated trading bot for the BNB Chain executing token trades based on predefined market conditions (Python).
An investor management panel for portfolio tracking and operations (React, Python FastAPI).
